decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: 150%;"><span style="line-height: 150%;">The side and rear
infill element would project beyond the side elevation of the original
dwellinghouse and have a width more than half the original dwelling. The
proposal would not be within the tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A,
A.1(j) (iii) and (ja) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted
Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: 150%;"><span style="line-height: 150%;">The side and rear
infill element and the side extension would have an eaves height which would exceed
the eaves of the existing dwellinghouse. The proposal would not be within the
tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A, A.1(d) of the Town and Country
Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: 150%;"><span style="line-height: 150%;">The side dormer would
have a resultant roof space with a cubic content of 50.58m<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">3, this is
above the 50m3</span></font> permitted for a semi-detached dwellinghouse. The
proposal would not be within the tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B, B.1
(d) (ii) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)
(England) Order 2015 as amended.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>
description: CERTIFICATE OF LAWFUL DEVELOPMENT(PROPOSED): Single storey side extension; single storey rear extensions; alterations to roof; side dormer
